messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anya Rao <anya@seedwell.com>, Tom Mulgrew <tom.mulgrew@seedwell.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap — next steps & three-week demo swing

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep dive: 

Summary (very high-level)
- Use case: Seedwell wants to embed Redwood-powered summarization and search into clinician workflows (PHI-scope TBD).
- Priority: start with a pilot for a single hospital network, then scale.
- Constraints: preference for private deployment or dedicated capacity; SOC 2 evidence requested.

Immediate asks / qualifiers I captured:
- Target pilot start: Q1 2026 (internal buy-in window)
- Primary stakeholders: Product (Anya), Ops (Tom), Eng/Infra (eng-lead@seedwell.com)
- Success metrics: latency < 350ms p95 on sample traffic, inference cost target TBD

Next step proposal
- Technical deep dive / demo (90 minutes) with Eng Lead + Infra on the call.
- Because we need to coordinate across US / EU / APAC stakeholders, propose a 3-week rotating demo cadence so each region gets an attendee-friendly time once every three weeks. Suggested rotation (local times below):
  * Week A (US-friendly): Tue 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 GMT — target for Anya/Tom in PST/EST
  * Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 3:00 PM CET / 9:00 AM ET / 23:00 SGT — target for EU engineering attendees
  * Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 10:00 AM SGT / 3:00 AM GMT / 8:00 PM PT (previous day) — target for APAC engineering/ops

I've opened a short Calendly poll to capture availability across those bands: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-poll/seedwell (please pick any slots that work for your Eng Lead).

Attachments: Seedwell-Discovery-Notes.pdf (call notes), MAP-Seedwell.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) — will update after you confirm attendees.

Can you confirm: (1) Eng Lead's preferred timezone window, (2) whether SOC 2 evidence is required before the deep dive, and (3) any non-negotiable attendees? If that sounds good, I'll provisionally block the suggested Week A slot for the first demo and send a calendar invite pending your confirmation.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez

Thanks Diego — very helpful recap. Quick notes from our side:
- Eng Lead (Marcus Chen) is available but prefers late-morning CET or early-morning ET; he can do Tue/Wed mornings CET but not late evenings.
- SOC 2 evidence: we will want the SOC 2 report before procurement signs off, but for the deep dive we can proceed if we get the relevant sections (data handling, isolation) ahead of time.

Regarding the proposed rotation, two asks: (1) can we avoid slots that start before 8:30 AM CET for our EU eng team, and (2) for APAC do you have any mid-day SGT options instead of late-night GMT?

I'll loop Marcus directly once we have proposed dates — he'll confirm the specific windows. For scheduling, we prefer a single calendar poll that lists the three candidate bands.

Tom

Appreciate the quick reply, Tom — and noted on Marcus' preferences. To address the asks and keep the rotation simple, here's a refined proposal that avoids early CET starts and provides a less disruptive APAC window. The goal is to make each band tolerable for the primary region while keeping the three-week cadence.

Refined three-week swing (local examples)
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET / 18:00 GMT — still friendly for US attendees, slight shift later to reduce overlap with EU mornings.
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 11:00 AM CET / 5:00 AM ET / 18:00 SGT — moves EU band into late morning (avoids before 8:30 CET).
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 2:00 PM SGT / 5:00 AM GMT / 9:00 PM PT (previous day) — APAC gets a mid-day demo rather than overnight.

Operational notes
- First deep dive: propose Tue, 18 Nov 2025 at Week A time (provisionally Tue 10:00 AM PT). If Marcus confirms that week/day works, I'll send the invite and include a short pre-read.
- Prep: Ben — can you prepare the infra-focused portion (20 min) and a short slide on cadence for autoscaling? Vivek — please be ready to speak to Dedicated vs Private deployment considerations and expected lead times.
- Compliance: Monica, I'll share the SOC 2 sections we have. If you can assemble the specific questions Marcus needs, we'll get those answers to Seedwell ahead of the deep dive.

I've updated the MAP draft and attached it (MAP-Seedwell.xlsx). Calendly still live if they'd prefer to pick a different band: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-poll/seedwell

Cheers — Diego
